question: What is the phone number and extension number for the school that had the 333rd highest average writing score?
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching schools record.
gold: SELECT T2.Phone, T2.Ext FROM satscores AS T1 LEFT JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332
gold0: SELECT T2.Phone, T2.Ext FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC LIMIT 332, 1

d.request: What is the phone number and extension number for the school that had the 333rd highest average writing score, keeping rows that have no matching schools record?
d.sql: SELECT s.Phone, s.Ext FROM satscores AS t LEFT JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE t.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332

b.request: What are the phone number and extension of the school with the 333rd highest average writing score in satscores, keeping satscores rows that have no matching schools record (so the phone and extension may be null)?
b.sql: SELECT s.Phone, s.Ext FROM satscores AS t LEFT JOIN schools AS s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE t.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.AvgScrWrite DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332
